bug_report: Customer secrets are showing up readable in the log pipeline - a nested request payload reached the aggregator with its user_password and api_key values in plain text. Only a couple of top-level fields ever get scrubbed. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix redact so secrets stop leaking into logs, without breaking existing behaviour.

conversations.text: The compliance audit flagged that our log events ship secrets in plain text — a nested request payload with a user_password went straight to the aggregator, readable.
I'll extend redact to walk nested dicts and lists and mask any key whose name contains a sensitive word — password, token, api_key, ssn, card_number, email — replacing the value with '***'.

Two corrections. First, do NOT mask email — support answers tickets by looking customers up by email, and the last time someone scrubbed it we couldn't answer tickets for a week. Second, 'contains' is too broad; match on how the key ends.
OK — suffix match, so user_password and session_token still hit. Should I lowercase keys before matching? We see header-style keys like X-Api-Key in these events.

Yes — normalize the key first: lowercase it and turn every run of non-alphanumerics into an underscore, so X-Api-Key becomes x_api_key and matches the api_key suffix. One more thing about card numbers: support reconciles chargeback disputes by the tail digits, so a full mask breaks them.
How much of the card number should survive redaction?
The last 4 digits. Write it as *** plus the last4, like ***1234. Everything else sensitive is a plain ***.

Final rule: normalize the key (lowercase, non-alnum -> underscore); sensitive if it ends with password, token, api_key, ssn, or card_number; value becomes '***', except card_number which keeps its last4 as '***1234'; email is never masked; applied recursively through nested dicts and lists.

policy: suffix-match {password,token,api_key,ssn,card_number} recursively; card keeps last4; email stays
non_guessable: email carve-out + card last4, not full-masking which passes the repro
